gate._resolution_disclosure: The subject's gate requires IPD >= 120px (intake.MIN_IPD_PX) and the averageness path >= 280px (averageness_band.MIN_IPD_PX_OUTER). FairFace 448px crops give a median IPD of 66-67px, so ZERO faces from this source can meet it and the shipped 825-face bank never did either (measured 2026-09-07: race_landmarks.npz medians 66.5-69.8px). Applying the resolution leg would empty the bank; dropping it silently would be the mismatch it exists to prevent. It is therefore RECORDED as unmet and carried as claim `bank-resolution-mismatch-is-measured-not-hidden`.
gate.at_rest: averageness_band.posture_ok — the subject's own mouth-posture gate
